Freelance Time Tracker

Track billable time per client and project: start/stop timer, automatic log saved in your browser, per-client totals and CSV export for invoicing.

📖 How to use

  1. Type the client and project, then press Start — the timer runs live.
  2. Press Stop to log the session with its exact duration.
  3. Review the log below: edit nothing, delete mistakes, see per-client totals.
  4. Export CSV when it is time to invoice.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where are my time entries stored?

In your browser's localStorage, namespaced to this tool. They persist across reloads on the same device and browser.

What if I close the tab mid-session?

The start timestamp is saved immediately, so reopening the tool resumes the running timer from the original start time.

Can I log time manually?

Yes — the manual entry form adds a session for a past date and duration, e.g. for work done offline.
